entries.classification_evidence: windows 3.11 only (4840 ran, failures=6, errors=1, skipped=122; ubuntu 3.11/3.12/3.13/3.14 PASS 4843; local darwin 4843 OK). Two causes, read from the job log (job 109296711883). (1) PRODUCT (C2-P2-FINDING-001, aisef2/probe/cli_invocation.py): the child harness redirects the subject's fds 0/1/2 onto files opened with os.open without O_BINARY, so on Windows each capture fd is a CRT text-mode fd that translates newline to CRLF a second time, after the platform's text stdout already did (stderr 'forged' plus newline captured as 9 bytes = CR CR LF; a pre-step's 'abc' plus newline as 6 bytes), and the harness left the platform's newline translation of the standard text streams in place; the captured bytes, and every exact stream verdict over them, therefore depend on the platform (CLICAL-1 exits_streams positive observed REFUTED, CLI-1 REFUTED, CLI-5 size, CLI-7 REFUTED, CLICAL-3 stdout digest, FM2-CLI-SUBJECT-5 stderr digest) — a verdict must be a function of the revision, the spec and the probe identity only. (2) test timing (tests/v2/test_c2_cli_invocation.py FM2-CLI-SUBJECT-3): the controller stop is scheduled at a fixed 0.5 s after the range starts, which on the Windows runner can precede DISPATCHED, where a stop is a harness failure and not an interruption (ProbeInterrupted not raised). Fixed by a new candidate; this attempt stays FAILED.

entries.classification_evidence: windows 3.11 (4841 ran, failures=3, skipped=122): the six newline failures of d986ffc are gone (C2-P2-FINDING-001 corrected); two failures are the stale mutation evidence shared with every unit job of this commit (see the ubuntu entries, DEVELOPER); the third is C2-P2-FINDING-002, aisef2/probe/cli_invocation.py: tests/v2/test_c2_cli_invocation.py FM2-CLI-SUBJECT-3 (a controller stop after DISPATCHED) still reported no interruption although the stop now lands after DISPATCHED — so the fixed-delay hypothesis recorded for d986ffc was not the cause. Mechanism, read from aisef2/runtime/process_range.py: on Windows the controller's TerminateJobObject takes the range's anchor down with the job (P4-FINDING-007), the anchor never reports EXITED, ProcessRange.wait returns None, the probe's poll runs to the end of the window and concludes 'the harness process ended and its exit status was never reported' (HARNESS_FAILED) without asking the controller's ledger — every other post-DISPATCHED path goes through python_callable._after_dispatch (§9.3). Reproduced deterministically on every platform by a test double (a range whose wait never reports, with a TerminateJobObject stop in its ledger): ProbeInterrupted not raised before the correction, raised after. Not retried; corrected by a new candidate.

entries.classification_evidence: windows 3.11 only (4842 ran, errors=10, skipped=122; ubuntu 3.11-3.14 PASS 4845 — the stale-mutation failures of ac3ae16 are gone, and FM2-CLI-SUBJECT-3 passed here, so C2-P2-FINDING-002's correction held on Windows). C2-P2-FINDING-003, aisef2/probe/cli_invocation.py: ten cases (CLICAL-1 exits and blocks, CLICAL-2, CLICAL-3, CLI-1, CLI-5, CLI-6 x3, the layout-invariance case) errored in tempfile.TemporaryDirectory cleanup of the probe-owned evaluation directory with PermissionError [WinError 32] 'being used by another process' on harness.log (the file the range's anchor and the harness inherit as stderr; the harness's working directory is ws/ inside the same directory). The probe closes its own handle to harness.log right after the range starts and releases the range (measured empty, anchor reaped) before the directory is disposed, so the holder was not this process and no member was alive by the range's measurement; which process still held the handle (a member TerminateJobObject had just ended, whose handles were not yet closed, or another process of the runner) was NOT identified. Measured: WinError 32 in the Windows job log of d986ffc 0 times, of ac3ae16 0 times, of 98b5a04 20 times (10 directories); that job ran 3203 s against 2919 s and 2984 s; the diff of 98b5a04 against ac3ae16 touches only the post-window branch of _watch and a test double, which none of the ten cases reaches (they end on RESULT or on an absent subject) — innocent. The probe's disposal of its own directory assumed that a released range leaves nothing holding files inside it; on Windows that does not hold for a moment after TerminateJobObject. Not retried; corrected by a new candidate (bounded retry of the probe-owned directory's disposal on a sharing violation, raised if it persists).
